title: My mall house
content: My reoccurring dream is that the house I currently live in has pretty much the same layout but there is an extra door at the end of the hallway that leads to an underground tunnel (which is weird because I have a basement and this tunnel would be on the first floor in reality) Weird and scary shit happens in the tunnel. I hate going in there, it's unsettling but it leads to really different places that I feel like I "have to go" to. The tunnel has several exits, one leads to an abandoned mall, I have learned to avoid it because that's where the nightmares are. Another one goes to the high school I went to. Sometimes it's like a flashback and everything seems normal but other times its abandoned and has a dark energy. One exit is a huge meadow full of wildflowers. I haven't explored all of the exits but one took me to an old elaborate city. One building in particular has a big courtyard with fountains and marble statues. People walking around in clothes from different periods. Everything from togas to sweatpants. It has a staircase entry that is so wide and grand I can barely describe it. It's flanked on both sides with white marble columns. There are gold accents on everything. The doors are so big it's like they were made for a giant but they swing open easily. I think it's a library of sorts but all of the content is in drawers that are impossibly deep. Like a filing cabinet that has endless drawers that are 50 feet deep. It's full of bound ancient papers with weird writing that I can't recognize. The place I go to the most is in a lakefront campgrounds. The building looks like a little cabin. I go up a rickety set of 3 stairs and go into a place where I am often greeted by passed loved ones and pets. It has a huge wall of stained glass with a giant blue peace sign in the middle. It's comforting and the most peaceful place I know.
